checks: Differentiate Γ(u+tv)=sqrt(1+2γt+(vᵀΣv)t²). The resulting normalized margin derivatives are k and −2γk−ηm. The −2γk term integrates to zero at the fixed-source local normal minimum, while ∫mψ(q)dμ/h=A−bS.
For the outward kernel, ∫ψ(q)dμ=hS and −1≤q≤0 on its support, giving −hS≤A≤0. Polarization gives the stated covariance block, and radial and pure-base directions have zero normalization correction.

For each hinge the smooth second term is j times the strict positive-side indicator. Its passage through the integral uses the uniform normal expansion and the null volume of each endpoint plane, including a supporting plane.

For the linear hinge residual, integrating over the crossing interval gives a triangle of area k²/2. The positive-side body keeps only the triangle with k<0 and the negative-side body only the one with k>0. Thus the directional second derivative is [k]₋² or [k]₊² at a supporting endpoint, and the central coefficient averages the two and gives half of k². The lower endpoint enters positively and the upper negatively.

Interior and relative-interior normal-column geometry, the common O(t) strip bound, and the null relative boundary justify the trace integrals. In d=1 section coarea counts a point. Without positive-area supporting endpoints the indicator-difference argument differentiates the gradient with a uniform directional limit and gives the ordinary Hessian.
Source 8bc6ff090380166a §§1–2 (1)–(3) contains precisely the normalized curvature and endpoint cases. The frozen proof expands the corner argument without adding shape or cap-regularity hypotheses.
